children: ARC Group Securities Acquisition I announced holders may separately trade Class A ordinary shares, warrants and rights beginning on or about Sept. 24, 2026.
Holders may elect to separate Units into Class A ordinary shares, warrants and rights starting on or about Sept. 24, 2026.
Separated securities will trade on Nasdaq under symbols FJDI (shares), FJDIW (warrants) and FJDIR (rights).
Units not separated will continue trading on Nasdaq under symbol FJDIU.
Holders must have brokers contact Efficiency, Inc., the transfer agent, to effect the separation.
